metadata.description: Crop profiles for Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh
Local core crops by Agro-Ecological Zone (AEZ) and upazila in Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh

High Barind Tract.notes: Drought-prone terrace; pulses and oilseeds conserve residual moisture after T. Aman.

High Ganges River Floodplain.notes: Calcareous floodplain; major spice (onion, garlic), pulse, and jute belt.

Chalan Beel.notes: Deeply flooded basin; Mustard-Boro and Garlic-Jute-Aman are common.

Active Brahmaputra-Jamuna Floodplain.notes: Char and active floodplain soils; mustard, chili, maize, and jute thrive.

Rajshahi:Godagari.notes: High Barind flagship zone for winter tomato, chickpea, mustard, and watermelon.

Naogaon:Niamatpur.notes: High Barind drought-prone upazila; Aman-Chickpea/Mustard-Mungbean improves soil fertility.

Natore:Singra.notes: Heart of Chalan Beel; Mustard-Boro-Fallow and Garlic-Jute-Aman.
